sections.name: limiter
sections.title: Per-user question limit and answer
sections.what: Keeps one limiter for the route, allows 30 questions per user per minute, checks the question text, and returns the planner answer.
sections.why: Likely reason: limits the cost and abuse of answering questions.
sections.watch_out: The limiter lives in the memory of the running server, so the limit resets on restart and may differ across copies.

summary: Lets a signed-in fan ask a question. The server returns the planner's answer and limits each user to 30 questions a minute and 300 characters per question.
purpose: Provides the question-and-answer feature while controlling how much work each user can cause.
why: The comment says the planner answers from the database and language only phrases verified facts, and the limit protects that work.
how: 1) Confirms the user is signed in. 2) Checks the per-user limit and refuses if it is used up. 3) Checks the question is text of at most 300 characters. 4) Passes the question to the planner and returns its answer.
inputs: A POST request with a JSON body containing a question. The signed-in user comes from the session.
outputs: A JSON answer from the planner, or an error with a readable message.
risks: The limit is kept in memory, so it resets on restart and may not be shared across several running copies of the app.
debug: If users see too many questions too soon, check the limit count and whether several server copies run at once. If answers are empty, check the planner service.
